name: Home server upgrade: Raspberry Pi 4 to HP desktop (Nextcloud)

mentions.name: Home server upgrade: Raspberry Pi 4 to HP desktop (Nextcloud)
mentions.description: This project replaces a Raspberry Pi 4 used as a personal home server with a more powerful HP desktop, continuing to self-host Nextcloud. The goal is to eliminate the overload the Pi suffers when opening heavy Nextcloud menus.
mentions.problem: The Raspberry Pi 4 is underpowered for Nextcloud, effectively self-DDOSing whenever a resource-heavy menu is opened.
mentions.source_excerpt: I will be replacing the Raspberry Pi 4 I use as a home server with a more powerful HP desktop. I am getting tired of DDOSing myself whenever I open the wrong menu on Nextcloud.
